_documentation: Configuration for scripts/sync-bios.py. See docs/bios-setup.md for the step-by-step on creating the Google Form, linking it to a Sheet, and filling in the URLs below. While `csv_url` is empty, the workflow runs but no-ops.

columns.name: Full name (with title — Dr / Prof / Mr / Ms)
columns.position: Position or current role (e.g. PhD candidate, Associate Professor, Policy analyst)
columns.public_email: Public email (optional, will be shown on the site)
columns.wgs: Working Group involvement (tick all that apply)
columns.consent: I consent to publication of my bio on netsec-cost.eu
